subject: [hw] IP -> root: buffer sizing fix; current shas build_ios e465... / ios 81a6...
body:
One late fix before the phone: OPEN_OK.out_buf_bytes now advertises a full NV12-sized access-unit allowance (w*h*3/2, clamped 1..16 MiB, +64 KiB), not w*h/2. A 1080p key frame can exceed the old ~1 MiB and would have been rejected E_HW. Clients allocate what OPEN_OK says, so probe/P03 just get a larger buffer.

Current products:
  build_ios.sh: vcodecd 391648 bytes sha256 e465bba0f0df13f87986bc8f982592405ac2b512126d8523da2bb1bf7eb673d5
  ios/build.sh: vcodecd 386048 bytes sha256 81a6590f3ccceb152f69eae7902210846dc82a20eb2bc79584bb27d3959b3fd7
  n2vcd_cli 70000 b62f3cbe..., rwjpeg_tool 68432.
Tests: N2TEST IP PASS 765/765. Both vcodecd have shims/no fake. --venc-slow remains removed; slbc 0.
